name: Direct cached parent origin lookup

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: In `TaffyLayoutEngine::layout_bounds_for`, read an existing parent from `absolute_outer_origins` before recursively resolving its bounds. Preserve the recursive fallback when the origin is absent. Experiment 24 measured 1,005 parent-origin hits and zero misses per warmed frame, so this should eliminate 1,005 redundant `absolute_layout_bounds` hash lookups and helper calls without changing behavior.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Run three fresh checkpoint headed WebGPU Test Suite processes at DPR 1 and DPR 2 before editing. Change only the parent branch in `crates/gpux/crates/gpui/src/taffy.rs`; retain recursive fallback and update existing diagnostic hit/miss accounting to describe the direct origin cache. Run package formatting, all 456 gpui tests, two sequential 52/52 gpui_wgpu diagnostics suites, native checks with diagnostics off/on, single-thread WASM diagnostics check, warning-denied Clippy, and three fresh candidate browser processes. Require established-counter parity, layout calls 3661 to 2656, bounds hits 2574 to 1569, parent hits 1005, parent misses 0, zero terminal errors, and non-regressing three-process medians.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown: Remove exactly 1,005 helper invocations and bounds-map probes per warmed frame while preserving the 1,005 parent-origin hits and zero misses. Expect a modest acknowledged-throughput or paced-p95 improvement; reject on any correctness, counter, static, or material performance regression.

playwright: Three fresh checkpoint headed Chromium/WebGPU processes passed both DPRs with one worker and zero terminal errors.
rayx: The first candidate gate failed because cargo fmt --check required rustfmt's continuation indentation in the direct-origin branch. Atomic discipline required immediate revert before compilation.
counters: All six checkpoint frames reproduced 3661 calls, 2574 bounds hits, 1005 parent-origin hits, and 0 parent-origin misses.
